issue: The aggregate attempt fields in commissioning-matrix.json are inconsistent with the same file's per-cell repeatability rule and with the executed journal counts.
interpretation: The configuration field maximum_attempts_per_cell_per_platform=4 is the discovery-attempt limit; the two explicitly declared repeats are additional. The effective hard bounds are the per-cell bounds above. The aggregate fields of 21 are retained unchanged as part of the pre-execution record but are not valid aggregate caps.
disposition: Every final candidate cell, repeat, mechanism case, production case and negative control remained within its explicit per-case or per-cell bound and watchdog. The stale aggregate fields are an investigation-record qualification, not a BoltSharp defect and not evidence that an individual experiment was unbounded. This reconciliation does not rewrite the pre-execution matrix and does not authorize an aggregate-cap claim.
